verdict.rationale: Relay ships domain-specific recurring automation: recurring invoices (Pricing page), rule-based auto-transfers that split deposits by dollar amount or percentage and sweep excess cash to savings, and automated approval rules. A community user confirms automatic partitioning works but says external payments still have to be executed manually. These are fixed banking automations triggered by deposits or invoice cycles, not general scheduling of user-defined jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: arbitrary user-defined scheduled workflows, documented scheduled or recurring outbound payments and bill pay, time-based cron-style scheduling controls, API or agent-driven scheduling, and in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of recurring invoices.
